name: Ear Consistency Analysis
description: Detects temporal inconsistencies in ear shape, position, and symmetry across video frames.
useCase: Identifying deepfakes by analyzing ear morphology stability over time
mechanism: Tracks ear landmarks across frames and measures geometric consistency. Ears are highly individual features that deepfake models frequently fail to reproduce consistently, showing warping, asymmetry changes, or disappearing details between frames.
source: Nguyen, H. et al. (2019) - Multi-task Learning For Detecting and Segmenting Manipulated Facial Images and Videos, BTAS
algorithm: Ear Landmark Detection + Geometric Consistency Tracking + Temporal Stability Scoring
parameters: Landmarks: 55-point ear model, Tracking window: 10 frames, Metrics: shape stability, symmetry ratio
strengths:
• Ears are often overlooked by deepfake generators
• Stable biometric feature in natural video
• Complements facial analysis methods
• Works even with partial face occlusion
limitations:
• Requires visible ears (fails with hair covering)
• Lower accuracy on profile views
• Sensitive to video resolution
• May struggle with intentional ear accessories

references.title: Nguyen, H. et al. (2019). Multi-task Learning For Detecting and Segmenting Manipulated Facial Images and Videos. BTAS.
Matern, F. et al. (2019). Exploiting Visual Artifacts to Expose Deepfakes and Face Manipulations. WACV.
Yang, X. et al. (2019). Exposing Deep Fakes Using Inconsistent Head Poses. ICASSP.
